protocol.selection: Member checkpoints/architectures/alpha fixed on original calibration; equal weights predetermined here, no assessment selection
protocol.baseline: Mean predictions of the same full-label LGB fit seeds, not a single seed
protocol.seed_uncertainty: Average member daily statistics before block resampling; shared dates are not independent samples
protocol.assessment_status: Previously inspected public-train development dates; not final blinded data

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

paired_daily_interval.note: Day-mean diagnostic, not a confidence interval for Kaggle score.

mean_seed_daily_gain_interval.note: Day-mean diagnostic, not a confidence interval for Kaggle score.

wrapper_replay_scope: One full assessment day for the wrapper/load path; all member predictions replayed on all selection/assessment days.

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present
